projects.name: Workflow Studio — Enterprise Workflow Builder
projects.tech: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, XYFlow, Zustand, React Hook Form, Zod, Vitest, Playwright, axe-core
bullets: Built a drag-and-drop approval workflow builder with Start, Task, Approval, Decision, Notification and End steps using React, TypeScript and XYFlow, with undo/redo, zoom, fit-to-view, browser persistence and JSON import/export.

Implemented business-rule validation (single start step, reachable end steps, required approver roles, valid decision branches, unreachable steps and loop detection) that blocks publishing of invalid workflows.
Developed a simulation engine that routes requests by configurable conditions, such as sending purchases above ₹50,000 to finance approval, and records a complete action history.
Targeted WCAG 2.1 AA with keyboard alternatives to drag-and-drop, accessible dialogs, live-region status messages and Light, Dark and System themes; axe-core reports 0 violations across key screens.
Wrote 44 Vitest and React Testing Library tests and 29 Playwright end-to-end, accessibility and responsive tests, run in GitHub Actions CI.
